visualCharacteristics: 2-slide car model slider with day/night theme toggle. Full-viewport slides: product image centred over a full-bleed scene background, heading + description + two CTAs (outlined 'Explore now', text 'Download brochure') bottom-left, large circular prev/next arrows at mid-height, progress-bar indicators bottom-centre, day/night toggle bottom-left.
contentPattern: Per slide (row): cell 1 day image + alt; cell 2 optional night image + alt; cell 3 richtext with h2/h3 model name, description paragraph, 'EXPLORE NOW' link, 'DOWNLOAD BROCHURE' PDF link. Day/night scene backgrounds are block-level styling (CSS background, swapped via the .is-night state class).
